cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(HoroRuntimeUiSdkContract LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(HoroEngineGameplay REQUIRED)
if(TARGET HoroEngine::RuntimeUi OR TARGET HoroEngine::Physics)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Default gameplay SDK imported an optional runtime capability")
endif()
find_package(HoroEngineGameplay REQUIRED COMPONENTS RuntimeUi)
if(TARGET HoroEngine::Physics)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "RuntimeUi SDK selected Physics")
endif()
# Both components must share their common imported targets without duplicate ownership.
find_package(HoroEngineGameplay REQUIRED COMPONENTS Physics RuntimeUi)
horo_add_gameplay_module(HoroRuntimeUiSdkModule MODULE_ID game.ui_sdk NO_MANIFEST SOURCES RuntimeUiModule.cpp)
target_link_libraries(HoroRuntimeUiSdkModule PRIVATE HoroEngine::RuntimeUi)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/artifact-$<CONFIG>.txt" CONTENT "$<TARGET_FILE:HoroRuntimeUiSdkModule>")
